# TagBot

A tag bot using **TagScript** and TypeScript for dynamic, customizable responses.

<Cards>
  <Card href="/docs/discord-bots" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-bots/tagbot
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- TagScript parsing
- Dynamic variable substitution
- Custom tag creation
- Tag management commands

## TagScript Example

```
{user.mention}, welcome to {server.name}!
You are member #{server.memberCount}.
```

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
